explanations: Possible typographical error when copying the p‑value from statistical output.
The authors may have reported a one‑tailed p‑value (≈ .039) instead of the two‑tailed value (.078).

review.impact: The recomputed p-value of 0.0782 for the condition × gender interaction (F(1,60)=3.21) exceeds α=0.05, whereas the reported p=.03 falls below it, so the statistical significance of this interaction would reverse, potentially altering any conclusions that depend on this interaction being significant.
